{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01VtykbMh86AfFEuNz2qJ4Jv","type":"tool_result","content":"255\tAggregated via Loki (if deployed to staging) or `docker compose logs <service>` directly. Prefer the former for cross-service trace analysis.\n256\t\n257\t---\n258\t\n259\t## Destroy / teardown (cost reasons)\n260\t\n261\tStaging costs ~24 USD/mo idle. If you genuinely don't need staging for a long stretch, tear it down:\n262\t\n263\t```\n264\tcd infrastructure/terraform/environments/staging\n265\tterraform destroy\n266\t```\n267\t\n268\tNotes:\n269\t- The Spaces bucket is `prevent_destroy = true`. Backup history survives teardown. If you really need to nuke it, remove the guard via `terraform state rm module.staging.digitalocean_spaces_bucket.staging_backups` AFTER taking a manual backup.\n270\t- The Reserved IP is managed out-of-band; `terraform destroy` only removes the assignment, not the IP itself. Release it in the DO UI if you want to stop paying for it (~4 USD/mo idle).\n271\t- Re-provision later is `terraform apply` + secret seeding again. Seeding from scratch is fine — staging data is synthetic.\n272\t\n273\t---\n274\t\n275\t## Cost (April 2026 rates)\n276\t\n277\t| Resource | Spec | Est monthly |\n278\t|---|---|---|\n279\t| DO Droplet | s-2vcpu-4gb | ~24 USD |\n280\t| DO Spaces | 250GB + egress | ~5 USD |\n281\t| DO Reserved IP | attached (free) / unattached (~4 USD) | 0-4 USD |\n282\t| Monitoring (DO built-in) | free | 0 |\n283\t| **Total (active)** | | **~29 USD/mo** |\n284\t| **Total (torn-down, IP reserved)** | | **~5 USD/mo** |\n285\t\n286\tRecommended cap: set `DO_MONTHLY_BUDGET_ALERT=50` in the DO billing alerts. Anything above that means something is wrong (runaway backups, droplet upgraded without review).\n287\t\n288\t---\n289\t\n290\t## Divergence tracking\n291\t\n292\tIf staging and prod ever genuinely need different service shape (e.g. staging runs a mock payment service), add the service to `docker-compose.staging.yml` (not the base). Also create `infrastructure/deploy/service-criticality.staging.yaml` and `required-signals.staging.yaml`, and point the workflow at them via `MANIFEST=`. Do NOT fork the base compose.\n293\t\n294\tUntil that day, the staging runbook reuses the prod criticality + signals manifests by path — same SSoT, zero drift risk.\n295\t\n296\t---\n297\t\n298\t## Troubleshooting\n299\t\n300\t| Symptom | First check |\n301\t|---|---|\n302\t| Staging deploy fails at \"pre-flight: required secrets\" | Something in `.env` missing — cross-reference `required-secrets.yaml` |\n303\t| Staging deploy fails at \"WS6 criticality gate\" | `docker compose logs <service>` for the failing service |\n304\t| Staging deploy fails at \"WS7 boot-signal gate\" | Service booted but skipped NATS mTLS / schema drift / migration — check the specific missing signal in the workflow output |\n305\t| Prod gate never passes | `deployed/staging-<sha>` tag missing — staging deploy never finished. Open the staging workflow for the same SHA |\n306\t| Prod gate passed but deploy fails | Unrelated to staging gate. Normal prod deploy investigation |\n307\t| Image pull fails (`denied`) | Check `ghcr.io` login in the workflow + GitHub PAT for packages:read |\n308\t| DNS propagation slow | 300s TTL — wait 5 min; if the A record never resolves, check `terraform output dns_record_fqdn` and DO DNS dashboard |\n309\t\n310\t---\n311\t\n312\t## Ownership\n313\t\n314\t| Area | Owner |\n315\t|---|---|\n316\t| Runbook content | platform-ops |\n317\t| Terraform module | infra-expert (reviewed by security-reviewer for firewall rules) |\n318\t| Staging secret rotation | follows `docs/runbooks/secret-rotation.md` — cadence identical to prod |\n319\t| Bypass approvals | on-call incident commander |\n320\t\n321\tLast review: 2026-04-14 (WS9 Phase 1 landed).\n322\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"f1416d43-aadd-4676-a7d7-d4bba2d47165","uuid":"a21a63a1-2173-4aa5-a483-6e5cf877599d","timestamp":"2026-10-08T06:39:06.277Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-evidence-judge-50c7a29ef484/docs/runbooks/staging-environment.md","content":"Aggregated via Loki (if deployed to staging) or `docker compose logs <service>` directly. If you genuinely don't need staging for a long stretch, tear it down:\n\n```\ncd infrastructure/terraform/environments/staging\nterraform destroy\n```\n\nNotes:\n- The Spaces bucket is `prevent_destroy = true`.
